attempts.text:
{"test_cases": [
    {"id": "TC1", "title": "Positive Test for Correct Email and Password", "type": "positive",
     "preconditions": "User is registered and has a valid email and password.",
     "steps": [
         "1. Enter the registered email and correct password.",
         "2. Click the login button."
     ],
     "expected_result": "User is redirected to the account dashboard.",
     "covers": ["AC1"]
     },
    {"id": "TC2", "title": "Negative Test for Correct Email and Wrong Password", "type": "negative",
     "preconditions": "User is registered and has a valid email and password.",
     "steps": [
         "1. Enter the registered email and wrong password.",
         "2. Click the login button."
     ],
     "expected_result": "Page shows 'Invalid email or password'.",
     "covers": ["AC2"]
     },
    {"id": "TC3", "title": "Negative Test for 5 Failed Attempts in a Row", "type": "negative",
     "preconditions": "User is registered and has a valid email and password.",
     "steps": [
         "1. Enter the registered email and incorrect password 5 times in a row.",
         "2. Click the login button after each incorrect attempt."
     ],
     "expected_result": "Page shows 'Invalid email or password' and account is locked for 15 minutes.",
     "covers": ["AC3"]
     },
    {"id": "TC4", "title": "Negative Test for Empty Email Field", "type": "negative",
     "preconditions": "User is registered and has a valid email and password.",
     "steps": [
         "1. Leave the email field empty and enter the correct password.",
         "2. Click the login button."
     ],
     "expected_result": "Page shows 'Email is required'.",
     "covers": ["AC4"]
     }
]}
